$version: v03 (2026-11-13). v02 and v01 are kept in _archive/
$description: Sidra Coffee design tokens. SYSTEM TEST, fictional client. Source: 04-identity/01-direction/creative-direction.md (approved 2026-11-13) as amended by creative-direction-amendment-01.md and -02.md. CMYK values are uncalibrated approximations. Pantone references and ICC-calibrated CMYK are waived for system test; required before print (decision log 2026-11-13, ruling e).

paper.cmyk_status: approximate; ICC-calibrated CMYK waived for system test; required before print
paper.pantone: waived for system test; required before print

crema.cmyk_status: approximate; ICC-calibrated CMYK waived for system test; required before print
crema.pantone: waived for system test; required before print
crema.role: Warm second ground: panels, alternate pages, 250 g bag

ink.cmyk_status: approximate; ICC-calibrated CMYK waived for system test; required before print; body text prints 100K
ink.pantone: waived for system test; required before print
ink.role: All text, the six unlit bars, rules

ember.cmyk_status: approximate; ICC-calibrated CMYK waived for system test; required before print
ember.pantone: waived for system test; required before print
ember.role: The lit bar; one headline or one field per layout; the 1 kg bag; on web, the one primary action button per screenful
ember.web_button: Web and app only: Ember may fill the single primary action button in each screenful, in addition to the lit bar. Within a screenful the button replaces the Ember field or headline. See 'button'.

ash.cmyk_status: approximate; ICC-calibrated CMYK waived for system test; required before print
ash.pantone: waived for system test; required before print
ash.role: Captions and small technical text, on Paper only

contrast.$description: WCAG 2.x contrast ratios, computed 2026-11-13 from the HEX values (foreground-on-background).

ink-on-ember.rule: graphics (bars, rules); text only at 24 px / 18 pt and above, or 19 px / 14 pt Bold and above; prefer paper-on-ember for any text
ink-on-ember.note: creative-direction.md section 2 gives 3.9; corrected to 3.19 in amendment 01 section 1

family.fallback_arabic: 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Geeza Pro', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif

figures.arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic Bold 700, unit in Arabic
figures.latin: IBM Plex Sans Light 300, regular width (v02: the 85% width was dropped because it needs the variable font)

files.latin: assets/fonts/ibmplexsans-static/ (static files; IBM Plex Sans 3.006 by their own metadata, download source not recorded)

size_px_screen_min.rule: Floor for captions and any other text on screen-only pieces (decision log 2026-11-13). Applies when a small piece scales the ladder down.

ladder_a4_document_pt.$description: A4 documents only (amendment 01 section 9). Adds section_title and cover_title to the identity scale. One section title per page; cover title on the cover only. Latin tracking only; Arabic is never tracked. Not for social, presentation or packaging formats.

ladder_social_1080_px.$description: Social formats 1080 px wide only: 1080x1080, 1080x1350, 1080x1920 (amendment 02 section 4). Screen ladder x 1.15. Display is a maximum: a longer headline drops to subhead or is rewritten; no sizes in between; one display headline per post.

space.$description: 4 px base. Use only these steps.

grid.gutter: 1/5 column for text layouts; 0 for full-bleed bands
grid.arabic_text_span: 4 columns from the right; secondary content 3 from the left
grid.english_text_span: 4 columns from the left; secondary content 3 from the right

bar_row.count_rule: Seven bars and one lit bar (the fourth) per row. The stacked pattern and the icon repeat three or more identical rows, so they show more than seven bars and more than one lit bar in total; the lit bars line up in one centre column. Never two lit bars in one row, never staggered, never fewer than three rows.
bar_row.not_a_chart: Nothing is labelled by, numbered by or tied to an individual bar (ruling f).

logo.clear_space: height of the letter dal in the wordmark = 0.269 x wordmark width, on all sides
logo.status: ladder accepted for the test (decision log 2026-11-13, ruling g). Screen sizes from pixel tests in 02-logo/_work; print sizes simulated at 600 dpi, not press-tested
logo.icon: v02, confirmed by the art-director (amendment 02 section 2): three stacked band rows (bar 1:2.6) filling the square, lit bars in the centre column. Seven bars count reliably from 41 px; switch size stays 48 px. Icon v01 is archived in 02-logo/_archive/.
logo.formats: SVG (source), vector PDF in 02-logo/pdf/, transparent PNG at 1x, 2x, 4x in 02-logo/png/

button.$description: Web and app screens only (ruling l; amendment 02 section 3). A screenful is what is visible without scrolling at 1440x900 and at 390x844.

primary.label: {color.paper}
primary.limit: one per screenful; replaces the Ember field or headline in that screenful

secondary.label: {color.paper}
secondary.alternative: 2 px ink outline with ink label on paper or crema

button.focus: 2 px ink outline, offset 2 px outside the button
button.never: ember as body-text or link colour; tints for states

motion.$description: Summary of amendment 02 section 1, which is the full text.
motion.easing: cubic ease-out, one easing for every move

bar_build.allowed: hard-edged wipe or hard cut, each bar in its final position and size
bar_build.forbidden: slide, scale, bounce, rotate, swap, fade, build-out
bar_build.order: reading order of the lockup: right to left for Arabic and bilingual, left to right for Latin-led

lit_bar.transition: bottom-up hard-edged fill or hard cut
lit_bar.forbidden: colour blend, glow, pulse, flash, any other bar lit, light travelling along the row

wordmark_and_arabic_text.transition: opacity fade of the whole word or line, or hard cut
wordmark_and_arabic_text.forbidden: letter by letter, wipe, holding part-way through a fade

motion.poster_frame: required; taken from the final hold, never from a build or a fade
motion.style: flat colour, square corners; no blur, shadow, gradient or texture
motion.sound: films work silent; sound only with a recorded licence
motion.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion shows the final state only
